doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

chapter: Photographs of the Creole Fiesta and family
title: First children riders and the granddaughter queen
summary: Photographs of the first children riders, floats and Barbara Ann as queen.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I'll just put them all. I'll save them all. Now there. Oh, wait. Now this is the thing I have to get at. They want to see this picture. Now the first children. This was the first children who rode in our first parade. Now this is the little girl who's going to be queen next year. Right here. So she was made this year. Cynthia. Cynthia Paul. And they're all children between eight and ten. Six, seven, and ten. This little girl lives back there. You should see how big she is. All there, all over here. And you know what? This is a wagon. This is a pedal, pedal wagon. And I threw a sheet over there. And we took off our oleander, oleander branches and just typed it on there. And a reporter from the Times-Picayune came out and this took his eye out of all the carriages and everything. He said, who decorated this float? I said, it's decorated. We just threw a sheet on there and just pinned those live branches on there. He took a picture of this and put this in the paper. This is the only one in the Times-Picayune. But the little children came out so plainly, didn't they? They killed the little children. They killed the little children. And he was in love with that float. He said, and it was nothing but a pedal wagon. That's all it was. Now this is another one. But they had more in that wagon than this one. See, this they just put a bunch. This one they just took a branch of my tree and nearly broke down all my trees. This is the other wagon they had. But they were cute children until now. Mm-hmm. This is my granddaughter from California. This is Joycelyn. Do you all make your own costumes? Yes, most of them. This is my secretary. She was a very good secretary, too. Now this hat, she told me she paid $25 for this hat. That's what year was this? 1955. And this is a hair braid hat that I've had for about 15 years. You know what hair braid is? That hair braid? Yes. Yes. About 15 years. And whenever I went, everybody used to go wild. I thought you could bend it any way you want. No. And you see how big and fat I am there?

No, Miss, uh, where we went Sunday. His daughter. Miss Talton, it says. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Talton. Maybe we went Sunday. She was a secretary then. She's a school teacher. Smart. Very smart woman. Very smart woman. And, uh, tell me when you get tired. Well, I think after this reel, but we still got some more time on it. Well, all right then. I don't know how tired you're getting. I am not. Just go on. We got tired.

Just let me know. This is Ms. Brown, Deborah Brown's mother's bed. Four-poster bed like I was telling you my grandmother had. But hers was even larger than this. You see those old-time four-poster beds. We took a picture of that when we were visiting her. I think you've seen this one.

This one. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Now I think you've seen this one with the board members. Now this is, this was taken at a, I think it was taken in this room, yeah. Now this is another float. This is the hair ride. Now this is a track, I think we had something we had ready and put hair in it. We had that in a parade that year, a hair ride. And this was, now you see we begin with the old fashion and then we end with the new, with the convertible. We put the convertible on the end of the parade, but the convertible blew out this time. Did you notice that? It pumped out, it pumped out right here. And it's brand new, brand new. They got it from the automobile place. Yeah, but the tire blew out a little. Something, brand new. Well anyhow, this is, these are the pass queens. Pass queens, we put them in the convertible. And put them last, you know. They show from the old to the old. Car-ball.
Car-ball, six in one. Car-ball, six in one. Yeah, that's the same. Now this is his granddaughter. She made a beautiful queen. Barbara Ann. She really did.
Barbara Ann's son of the daughter.

Barbara Ann's son of the daughter. Yeah, that's Deborah, Deborah Ann then, Sylvia. That's him and his granddaughter. He thinks so much of his granddaughter. I don't blame him. Don't blame him, she's so pretty. She has two children now. She looks like the youngest one of all that I've seen him do.
Yeah, she's so pretty. She has two children. You have great grandchildren. I have great grandchildren.
You know how I'm big now. Great, great.
